name: GXZ
headline: Intelligence, in motion.
statement: I explore how intelligent systems perceive space, understand movement, and turn observation into action.
aboutHeadline: I work between code and space.
about: My work connects spatial research, crowd analysis and embodied AI. Across these projects, I use observation, simulation and working prototypes to make complex behavior easier to inspect and question.
approach: Start with what can be observed. Build a way to test it. Stay precise about what the results can tell us.
